title: Ownership and component mailbox semantics
summary: There is one ACTIVE owner per component. Requests may be addressed to component:<componentId> before ownership; the eventual active owner gains visibility without rewriting historical requests. The active owner may explicitly release its claim, which appends immutable release evidence and makes the component claimable again.
invariants: Reclaim by the same owner is idempotent.
A different owner gets OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT; ownership is never implicitly stolen.
Only the authenticated active owner may release; another principal gets OWNERSHIP_RELEASE_FORBIDDEN.
Release appends OWNERSHIP_RELEASED evidence, removes only the active projection, and ALREADY_UNOWNED is idempotent.
Omitted request recipient resolves to current owner, else component mailbox.
